title: Full low-spectral-layer shorting on boundary rays
objective: Establish or sharply refute the full Loewner low-layer shorting inequality needed by the boundary-ray interpolation, retaining low/high cross blocks rather than proving only compression bounds.
acceptance_checks: Distinguishes full Loewner shorting from the known-insufficient compressed Rayleigh inequality.
Reproduces the rank-two elliptope and rank-four exterior barriers before proposing a general claim.
Covers multiscale low spectral layers rather than only a fixed boundary kernel.
Provides an explicit boundary-ray-to-positive-mu and strong expected-distance transfer for every positive conclusion.
